svg.text: Shared accessibility infrastructure for public institutions
ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ସୁଗମ ସେବା · an API · a widget · an extension
One API · One widget · One extension — accessibility for every citizen in Odia (ଓଡ଼ିଆ), Hindi & English

g.text: ❖ Govt & education sites are largely unusable for blind,
low-vision & dyslexic users — screen readers struggle.
❖ Content is English-first; Odia-only citizens are shut out.
❖ Every institution rebuilding accessibility from scratch
❖ Institutions integrate ONCE — a secure REST API + a
❖ A browser extension brings it to ANY site — no integration.

svg.text: two ways in → one Accessibility API Gateway → shared engines (also run on-device, offline)
Drop-in widget (1 line) · direct REST API
usage metering · rate limiting · WCAG logging
tenants · API keys · usage · WCAG results
Meta MMS-TTS — Odia · Hindi · English neural voices
Whisper — voice input to fill forms & search
AI4Bharat IndicTrans2 — English ↔ Odia / Hindi, Indic-tuned

On-device option: the extension runs MMS-TTS · Whisper · IndicTrans2 in-browser (offline, works on strict-CSP sites). Built on the platform: WCAG logging & admin oversight — per-tenant API keys, usage metering, compliance evidence.

g.text: Point at anything to hear it
